selection_rule: first four-day archive volume spanning June18-21 chosen from directory chronology and data-format availability, before opening measurements; no value-based selection
test_scope: Parser controls and physical bridge development. No gamma confidence interval until proper-time, ephemeris, ramp, transponder, media, finite-compression and covariance models are validated. Raw reserved tracks are not an independent experiment because the published aggregate is already exposed.
change_policy: Record every role/selection change and why before dependent measurement access; exposed tracks cannot regain blind status.
